summary: Create a record with one starter field. Add more fields to the generated array.
purpose: Use this when you want a reviewed code sample for creating one record on the server side.
learningGoals: Understand that create operations have side effects and should not auto-run from a beginner surface.
See the different server-side shapes for Data API and OData creation flows.
Start from one field and expand the payload carefully.
explanation: Create is intentionally code-only. It teaches the payload shape without letting a browser learning surface mutate live data.
commonMistakes: Running create logic against production data without a disposable test environment.
Forgetting that OData write flows need a protected route on the server.
Changing FileMaker field names to friendlier labels inside the payload.
expectedResult: You get server-side starter code for a create operation, but nothing auto-runs from the playground.

safety.confirmationText: Creating records changes data. Review the payload and test only in a disposable environment.

prerequisites: Use a disposable FileMaker environment before running create code.
Review every field name and value with the real schema owner.

beginner: Create changes live data, so this module only generates code for review.
Start with one field, then expand carefully after you confirm the schema.
Do not run create code from a browser playground against real customer data.
advanced: The PHP variants preserve the original playground output, including the OData payload-only starter.
